sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2-2.6B-Exp · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2-2.6B-Exp is an experimental checkpoint built on LFM2-2.6B using pure reinforcement learning. Specifically trained on instruction following, knowledge, and math, it delivers particularly strong performance compared to other 3B models. In particular, its IFBench score surpasses DeepSeek R1-0528 ...

sources.title: LFM2-2.6B-Exp - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: This model is deprecated. Use LFM2.5-2.6B for improved agentic capabilities and a 131K context window. LFM2-2.6B-Exp is an experimental checkpoint of LFM2-2.6B post-trained with pure reinforcement learning on instruction following, knowledge, and math.
